name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from a 40-month high of 54.3 in September, consistent with annualised global GDP growth of about 2.9% (S&P Global, 5 Nov). Business optimism fell to a five-month low amid heightened economic uncertainty. The reading remains above the 51 Watch line; November flash data are due later in the month.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, which supports trade and jobs. Falling business confidence can precede slower hiring and investment.

sources.title: S&P Global — Global PMI remains elevated in October but dips on heightened economic uncertainty

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
